subject: Partner Lift-Off: Integrator Bootcamp & Ops Codex
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@launchbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Integrator bootcamp to certify LaunchBridge engineers

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking a look. LaunchBridge is ramping three delivery teams to start joint engagements for the quarter of July-Aug. We want a compact partner bootcamp (2 full days) that covers: Redwood serving runtime basics, model variant selection, quantization tradeoffs, and runbook-driven handoffs to our SREs.

High level asks:
- Two-day format with a mix of slides + 4 hands-on labs (sandbox).
- Trainer + 6 attendees (engineers + one solutions PM).
- Access to a sandbox tenant + short-term eval keys.
- A condensed ops codex we can ship to our delivery leads.

Can you share a sample agenda and checklist? Dates we’re thinking: week of July 12 or July 19.

Looping in Marco (our enablement lead) in case we need logistics.

Appreciate it — Sarah

[signature]
Sarah Chen
Partnerships & Enablement
LaunchBridge Consulting
[attachment: launchbridge_company_card.vcf]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@launchbridge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Integrator bootcamp to certify LaunchBridge engineers

Hi Sarah — great to hear the timeline. Attaching a draft two-day agenda and our Ops Codex (v1) to start.

Quick summary of what I propose:
- Day 1: Foundations + hosted API deep-dive (streaming, tool-calling, catalog navigation).
- Day 1 labs (2): Quickstart app (chat + functions) and latency/cost instrumentation with Redwood Console.
- Day 2: Dedicated & Private patterns + runtime internals, batching & KV cache behaviors.
- Day 2 labs (2): Quantization/throughput lab and canary/rollback runbook drill with a staged rollout.

Pre-reqs we need from LaunchBridge:
- List of 6 attendees with roles and GitHub handles.
- Preferred training week (Jul 12 or Jul 19) and timezone constraints.
- Hostnames/IPs for sandbox allowlist (if you want private tenant access).

Operational asks from our side:
- We’ll provision a 72-hour sandbox per attendee and a shared project with limited credits.
- Mateo will provide a provisioning checklist and ephemeral keys.

Attachments: bootcamp_agenda.pdf (PDF, 28KB), ops_codex_v1.md (Markdown, 12KB)

If you confirm dates I’ll lock trainers and send a more detailed mutual action plan.

Thanks — Evelyn
Director, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Integrator bootcamp to certify LaunchBridge engineers

Thanks, Evelyn / Sarah — quick technical notes to make the labs smooth:

1) Sandbox topology
- For hands-on quantization and throughput labs we need GPU-backed sandboxes (A10G-equivalent). Each attendee will get a sandbox project with 3-hour reserved windows.

2) Credentials + quota
- Ephemeral API keys (24-72h TTL) scoped to the training project. Mateo will create a provisioning script so you don’t have to hand out long-lived keys.

3) Sample lab checklists (what I’ll cover in each lab)
- Lab 1 (Quickstart app): repo clone, env vars, run local dev + streaming response testing.
- Lab 2 (Observability): console traces, per-route cost breakdown, token-level latency analysis.
- Lab 3 (Quantization & perf): compare FP16 vs q4_0 settings, measure tail latency under batching.
- Lab 4 (Rollouts): canary traffic config, automatic fallback to hosted variant on degraded throughput.

Action: Mateo — can you stand up the project and provide the provisioning script by May 28?

-- Soojin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah — welcome aboard. Quick answers:

- Partner training discount: We provide a 30% partner enablement discount for first-time SI onboarding workshops (applies to trainer fee). Sandbox credits: Redwood will absorb the compute cost for the training sandboxes up to a capped amount (details in the attached Ops Codex).
- Demo data: You may bring anonymized datasets; PII must be scrubbed. If you need to validate a dataset, we can run a quick data review — Soojin, can ops approve sample review?
- Next steps:
  1) Sarah sends attendee list + timezones by 2027-05-25 EOD.
  2) Mateo provisions the sandbox project and posts ephemeral key script to the shared Drive link.
  3) Evelyn to send a mutual action plan and fill in trainer names by 2027-05-28.

I’ll draft the partner invoice template and share a short procurement checklist (PO, billing contact, contract term) once dates lock.

Welcome again — excited to get LaunchBridge certified.

— Vanessa
Head of Partner Operations
Redwood Inference
